The certificates, licences and skills whoever does the work must hold. Every order raised from this plan carries this list with it.
Declare it BEFORE starting. This is the list the competence gate checks — a labour-hour line recorded afterwards is only noted, it does not block.

Discovering an expiry on the very morning the crew has reached the foot\n               of the tower is information that can no longer be used for\n               anything. This list is for seeing it in advance.
Certificate %(ten)s expires on %(d)s — %(n)d days left. An expiry is a training scheduling failure, fixable within the week; finding out only once it has lapsed costs a crew half a day.
This is Odoo's own skills table, not a separate EAMOne one —\n so that HR and the maintenance crew do not keep two sources of\n truth about the same piece of paper.

Certificate validity is checked against the order's work date, not today — a certificate valid today that expires before the work date is still blocked.
Expired is a training scheduling failure, renewable within the week. Missing altogether is a workforce planning failure, taking months to make up — so the two are kept apart rather than lumped together as "not competent".
